lines.t: All your setting of dates shall come to nothing, and all your precise predictions shall fail.
For I may take them before or after. For I am God...
Therefore, keep watch, for you know not the time of The Lord’s coming...
Therefore, keep watch, for you know not the time of The Lord’s coming...
Behold, the first election is made, the time of bundling passed.
Thick clouds have risen in the west, the hard rains have come, and who in all the earth is able to prevent it as it draws near, or hinder it when it arrives?
Lo, a mighty wind blows in the east, yet who is aware of it, until it has overtaken them?
Whether it be in the first, or in the second,
or in the third watch of the night, you know not the time of His return...
You know not the day or the hour...
You know not the day or the hour...
Therefore, keep watch, for you know not the time of The Lord’s coming...
Therefore, keep watch, for you know not the time of The Lord’s coming...
You know not the day or the hour...
